column2: Hey, $$ピリポ$$! Hand that weapon over to me!
This is why muscleheads are such a pain.
Always trying to solve everything with brute force. That's why you're such a pain.
It's all about the brain! Is that thing on top of you just for decoration?
Heh, weak. All that matters is who's still alive at the end!
Damn, you got me good!! I've lost a lot of $$血$$. I'll pull back for now.
Damn it!! A pathetic weakling like you...
Watch closely! Get close enough before you hit them! That's how I do it!!
I've always admired the strong... Because strength is the only truth in this $$世界$$!
Now do you understand my strength?!
Doesn't even hurt! Not against this strongest body of mine!
No chance! That attack's like a fly landing on my head!
Huh? If you can't move well, does that make you harder to hit, too?
